p.title: The LIVE3-03 breadth fixture ran on the wall clock and failed the bot's data-commit CI at some hours
p.symptom: CI on refresh-data commits failed 9 times on 11/03 05:22-08:53Z at runtime 'LIVE3-03: 20SMA breadth ... fails closed' (plus data-pipeline). The commits were on main but converge refused them (UNATTESTED_REVISION), so the live site kept the older data for ~3.5 h; nothing in the code or data had changed.
p.root_cause: ci-runtime-contract-check.mjs built the breadth fixture with observedAt = Date.now() - 24 h and called readScreenerBreadth without a now. Session currentness depends on where 'now' falls against the US close, so 'a day ago' is the latest session at most hours and not at others.
p.fix: The fixture is pinned: observedAt 2026-10-14T20:30Z (after that US close) and BREADTH_FIXTURE_NOW 2026-10-15T02:00Z passed to every readScreenerBreadth call, the stale case 97 h before that.
p.violated_rule: Fixtures do not read the wall clock (v59.48 failure-ledger pass pinned the news audit the same way)
p.prevention: {R}: a contract fixture that judges currentness passes an explicit now; the check gives the same verdict at every hour.
p.verification: Date.now pinned to 11/03 06:00Z: HEAD fails LIVE3-03, the new check passes; at 11/03 12:00Z, 11/04 01:00Z and Sat 11/08 03:00Z both pass.

r.title: Currentness fixtures pass an explicit now
r.rule: A CI fixture that exercises session or age currentness passes a fixed now to the function under test and builds its timestamps from it, never from Date.now().

qa.text: v59.70: LIVE3-03 gives the same verdict at any wall-clock hour (fixture pinned to 2026-10-15T02:00Z)

changelog: **Data commits no longer fail CI by the hour (v59.70, {P}/{R}):** a breadth test built its sample from the wall clock and failed 9 bot data commits on 11/03, which then never deployed. It now uses a fixed time.
